title: Incident Response Team
summary: Triage, parallel diagnosis (reliability + security), a verified fix through a Dev↔QA loop, stakeholder comms alongside, and a blameless post-mortem.

nodes.task:
Triage this incident: {{input.incident}}

Severity (SEV1-4) with justification, blast radius, immediate mitigation to apply now, and the hypotheses to investigate.
Investigate the reliability hypotheses from triage. Identify the most likely root cause with evidence (metrics, logs, recent changes) and propose the fix.
Determine whether this incident has a security dimension (intrusion, data exposure, abuse). Assess indicators and state what evidence supports your conclusion.
nodes.verdict_guide: CLEAR = no security involvement. COMPROMISE = evidence of a security incident. UNKNOWN = cannot rule it out yet.

nodes.task: Run containment for the suspected security incident: isolate affected assets, rotate exposed credentials, preserve evidence, and list notification obligations.

inputs.task: Implement the permanent fix for the incident root cause identified by the SRE investigation.
inputs.acceptance: Root cause eliminated, regression test added, no new alerts under normal load, rollback plan documented.

nodes.task: Draft the customer-facing status page update and an internal stakeholder update for this incident. Factual, no speculation, next update time as a placeholder.

Write the blameless post-mortem: timeline, root cause, contributing factors, what went well, and action items (owner role, priority). Fix verdict: {{nodes.fix.verdict}}. Security verdict: {{nodes.security.verdict}}.
